title: Old photographs and clippings
summary: Bill Russell asks about surviving photographs and clippings. Foster thinks a man named Kaganary has a photograph of Buddy Petit's band.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: It's too bad you didn't save some of those clippings and papers. Sure have had, sure have had. Did you ever save any other photographs, any old photographs? We can make copies of them, like that one of Buddy Petit. You don't know of any other bands of Buddy, pictures of Buddy?

You know, I read it, there's so many, I see the boys over there. There's only a boy I think had one year by the name of Kaganary. I think he had the picture. Daniel 11? Yeah, I think he had the picture of it. Yeah? You know him. Yeah, yeah.
We missed, by the way we never did interview him yet, we ought to interview him pretty soon. Somehow we missed him, somehow we never did get to him.

Yeah, I think he has a picture of it. He told me, he has a picture of the band, you know, of the old things. Yeah, but he has a picture of it. Now, Count Hall, he may have been on that picture, I don't know. I don't think he was playing the band in the study acting. Well, I thought Edmund Hall was on that picture. I mean Edmund Hall, I mean Edmund Hall, I mean Edmund Hall, that's what I mean. It may be Edmund Hall if you don't think it's Fritz. Well, I… Fritz played with him, Edmund Hall was playing with the band. I've always been with the band. It's just a while or two, but I don't know if it's been my… It doesn't pitch it to you.
